about: Demo dataset for '@squad simulate'. Each channel is created in Discord and these messages are posted by persona webhooks, one at a time, so Squad Radar reacts as if real friends were chatting. {you} becomes a mention of whoever started the simulation. 'react' steps add a reaction to an earlier message ('to': -1 is the message just before). 'pause' is seconds to wait after a step. Edit freely.
